subtitulo: Reverse climate change. There is no money: only the planet.
semilla_ayuda: Two different seeds, two different worlds.
toca_celda: Tap a tile on the planet to see what you can build there.
nada_aqui: Nothing can be built on this tile yet.
politicas_ayuda: Big policies are paid with Hope.
err_bioma: That solution doesn't fit this biome.
revelada: Exposed: {nombre}. Its real effect was far smaller, and it costs the planet Life.
inf_permafrost: Tipping point: permafrost has started thawing. It releases emissions you can't switch off.
inf_corales: Tipping point: tropical coral reefs are bleaching. Life drops.
inf_amazonia: Tipping point: the Amazon is turning into savanna. More emissions.
choque: Termination shock: removing the aerosols brought the hidden heat back at once.
era2: New solutions unlocked: restoration, utility-scale solar, offshore wind and more.
dato: Real fact · {nombre}: according to Project Drawdown, it could avoid or remove {a}–{b} GtCO₂e per year.
dato_sin: Real fact · {nombre}: Project Drawdown hasn't published its potential yet; in the game it's an assumption.
fin_victoria_txt: Temperature peaked and fell for ten years in a row, with net-negative emissions.
fin_derrota_vida_txt: Without biodiversity, the planet stopped holding itself together.
fin_derrota_esperanza_txt: Without people who believe, there is no transition.
fin_derrota_tiempo_txt: 2150 arrived and the climate wasn't reversed.
pol_cerrar_carbon_txt: −15% energy emissions. Fossil lock-in makes it pricier.
pol_fin_subsidios_txt: The fossil economy starts shrinking on its own every year.
pol_moratoria_deforestacion_txt: −40% forest emissions; Life degrades much less.
ayuda_txt: Each turn is a year. Tap a tile, build a Project Drawdown solution and upgrade it. Solutions cost ⚡ and ⛏, which refill every year up to a cap: what you don't spend is lost. Look after Life and Hope: if either hits 0, you lose. Beware of traps: they're cheap and seem to work… until they're exposed. You win when temperature falls ten years in a row with net-negative emissions.
